what: Leidos provides technology services to the US government. It runs defence and intelligence systems, airport security screening equipment, veterans' health examinations and civil agency IT.
customers: US defence and intelligence agencies, civil government departments, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and allied governments.
money: defence and intelligence systems and IT
veterans' disability examinations and civil agency programmes
security detection and international defence work
moat: Incumbent positions on multi-year government contracts with security clearances and programme knowledge that make recompetes hard for outsiders to win.
risks: US government budget decisions and shutdowns affect contract timing
Government cost-cutting initiatives target services contractors directly
Revenue grew only about 3% last year
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 16% with a 12% operating margin
Analysts see about 22% upside from current levels
The veterans' health examination business has grown strongly and earns high margins
watch: Net bookings and the book-to-bill ratio, and health segment margins.
